propositions: Seven decorated pytest fixtures return complete dict(os.environ) copies that expose unrelated ambient credentials when pytest renders fixture arguments in long tracebacks via saferepr
Arbitrary inherited environment variables from the caller enter test output during unrelated assertion failures, creating a credential leak vector through pytest fixture argument serialization
Each affected fixture must replace its broad os.environ copy with an explicit allowlisted mapping containing only PATH, required state/path variables, and per-test mutable overrides
The fake-bin-first PATH and explicit harness environment variables must remain available and mutable to all existing fixture consumers after remediation
All 42 existing fixture consumers and the security oracle must pass under both minimal-parent-environment (env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin) and normal focused test suites with no behavioral regression
